director Alexander Payne and cast
Where were you last night? "Martha Marcy May Marlene" is terrific and we had a hot young crowd.

Here is the email I sent to the president ofFox Searchlight who was asking ME last night about the oscar race to date.

I NEVER would have been able to intelligently talk to him without all your suppon...friendship and travel aid. This is the
result of your investment...and I am forever gmatfid. We arc booked every night in Oct. and Nov. xoxo Peg

— Original Message --
From: Peggy Siegal
To:
Cc: Andres Fernandez; Stephanie
Sent: Wed Oct 12 08:21:33 2011
Subject: The Descendants screening and dinner Saturday, Oct. 15 NYC

Dear Steve:
Was fun miming the mouth on all my cockamamie theories on the Oscar race...and you know I never touch a drop of
drink...so all my indiscretions hopefully will stay within the family

My office is sending you the invite and yes list to date this morning and will keep you updated. Please note Rupert and
Wendi are coming. She emailed me directly...having at one point offering to host this evening.

If you can think ofany important interesting and hip filmmakers that are also academy members that you and Fox have a
relationship with to invite....that would be so appreciated.

If you need any currant cmails or phone numbers, we probably have that info too. The key words am NO PRESS. Of
course we will plant column items after. No reason to show one of the best films of the year and not tell all the voters.

Stephanie in my office will send you my Oscar Diary from last year, this year's Cannes and Venice Diaries.
They may shed some light on this year's race that has hardly begun or just make you laugh.

Fox Searchlight has one of the strongest line ups this year and we are all excited about working together.

xoxo Peggy
